classPolicy: Do not expose extracted CSS-module/hash classes as generated component API. Use semantic wrapper classes and data attributes; raw copied snippet internals may keep source classes only as implementation detail.

stateContract.checked: Set data-checked=true and aria-checked=true; preserve the selected visual variant.
stateContract.unchecked: Set data-checked=false and aria-checked=false; preserve the selected visual variant.
stateContract.disabled: Set data-disabled=true, remove keyboard focus from active flow, and preserve checked state if already checked.

preview: Toggle semantic checked state and ARIA together. Do not document or rely on extracted CSS-module class names as public API.
